pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal dark-brown regions with moderately sharp edge gradients; individual patches on the neck show greater longitudinal elongation compared to the more equilateral geometry of the patches visible on the shoulder.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-cream pathways forming a topological graph with primarily tri-radial junction nodes; pathway thickness is relatively uniform across the neck but exhibits slight narrowing at the transition to the dorsal ridge.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrated silhouette along the neck mane; individual hair tufts create a jagged 1D contour against the blurred background.

other_distinctive_markers: A dark, out-of-focus vertical structure (tail brush) is positioned in the foreground, partially occluding the shoulder and mid-body regions.
